segments.name: Distribution
segments.description: Distributes technology products from software vendors and OEMs to resellers, VARs, consultants and system integrators worldwide under Climb Channel Solutions.
segments.evidence: We purchase software, maintenance/service agreements, networking/storage/security equipment and complementary products from our vendors and sell them to our reseller customers.

segments.name: Solutions
segments.description: Acts as a cloud solutions provider and value-added reseller selling software, hardware and technical services directly to end users worldwide under Grey Matter.
segments.evidence: Products in this segment are acquired directly from OEMs, software developers or distributors and sold to end users.

revenueModel.text: Resellers, VARs and end users pay the company for third-party software licenses, maintenance and service agreements and related hardware.
revenueModel.evidence: We derive most of our net sales through the sale of third-party software licenses, maintenance and service agreements.
